comments.text: Release promotion blocked by required repository review. PR #591 opened from develop source 87a7de982b99a73e635fb24db8cb46a3110c8077 to main 36ab05927c4ee4d3b7ed15e2cb8d785c1822a00a, containing only #590 application changes plus existing Kanbus records. Read-only reviewer found no concrete functional defect and all five pure-helper tests passed, but requested changes because AGENTS.md requires Gherkin regression coverage for viewport recovery and drag/key/reset/persistence behaviors; #590 adds none. Promotion PR placed in draft and not merged. Exact promotion CI is pending. Main production workflows are workflow_dispatch only, so there is no automatic production deployment to follow. No deployments, permission changes or computer-image promotions were performed. Physical iPad testing remains unperformed. Follow-up: add the required behavior specifications in a scoped develop change, rerun exact promotion checks and review, then merge; explicit owner authorization is needed to waive the repository review gate instead.

right_now_summary: Promotion awaits required Gherkin coverage and review; no deployment or iPad testing has occurred.
